name: Tsunami of Nanyue deals 2 damage to all rested allies
notes: Tsunami of Nanyue's element is WATER, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real WATER champion (Spirit of Water) to unlock element access. Shifting Currents default to a non-South direction, so the base clause (2 damage to all rested allies on both sides) applies rather than the South-facing 3-damage-to-opponent-only clause. Without the Efficiency discount (champion is level 0), the full 5-reserve cost is paid, then both players decline the EffectStackActiveResponse opportunity window. A Dungeon Guide is seeded onto the opponent's field pre-rested (Status 1) as the sole rested ally in play.

rulesClauses: Deal 2 damage to all rested allies.
